710640101.text: O great Millelith heroes, please see to it that The Chasm does not act up these few days!

710640102.text: And may we be safe and sound as we descend into the mines this time, and may those comrades of ours who no longer come to mine also fare well in their respective paths. Protect us, brave Millelith, protect us...

710640103.text: Hmm? What is it? Can I help you?

710640106.text: Well, I'm praying at this Millelith memorial. I mean, it looks like a pile of unassuming rocks, but it's actually been here for five hundred years now!

710640107.text: The Chasm is under the protection of the Millelith, so every time we have people descend into the mines, we will pray here for the heroic souls of those who have passed to protect us.

710640108.text: They have long since turned into elements and become one with the mine, so when we pray for their protection, we're also showing our reverence to The Chasm itself, you know?

710640109.text: The ancients said that "the earth has a spirit, and the elements have souls." Those who sacrificed their lives so that we might live watch over us in similar fashion. So I believe...

710640111.text: That's right. Back then, a dark calamity swallowed The Chasm, and Rex Lapis commanded the Millelith to stand guard over the ore veins.

710640112.text: That was a terrible battle. Led by a Yaksha, the Millelith came forth to stem the tide.

710640113.text: In the end, a group of them led the foe into the depths of The Chasm, and thus quelled the unrest.

710640114.text: It is said that this memorial was set up for them.

710640115.text: Huh. Paimon didn't think that these ugly stones would have such history...

710640116.text: Hehe, don't disrespect the fallen, little one.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for offerings to place before the memorial

710640201.text: (This small stone tablet has the following words inscribed on it...)

710640202.text: ..."During the battle at The Chasm, I lost the use of my four limbs and thus was forced to dictate these words for someone else to record and carve here."...

710640203.text: ..."I survived that fierce battle, but each night where I thought of our fallen comrades was a sleepless one. And with my body in this state, oh, how I detested the fact that I was not privileged to join them."...

710640204.text: ..."I attempted to join them, only to have Rex Lapis hear of it and reprimand me, waking me from my stupor."...

710640205.text: ..."Alas, for I can no longer make use of his gift of Millelith armor and equipment. They shall only accumulate dust if left in my keeping, and so I leave them here for someone fated to come and claim them."...

710640206.text: ..."Everyone, though we can no longer do so in this life, let us be comrades again in the next. Let us then share the wine of sworn brotherhood once more, and defend Liyue from its foes!"...

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for offerings to place before the memorial

710640301.text: Oh, wow, you really found it! So... this is the "treasure of the Millelith," then?

710640302.text: Now, I've got no clue what's in there, but I'm sure that the soldier who left that treasure behind would be pleased to know that it was found.

710640303.text: It's been five hundred years since that disaster... When I think about how this place was once the site of such an intense battle, one in which countless forebears of ours sacrificed themselves, I can't help but wonder...

710640304.text: Did any of those people who went into battle alongside the Lord of Geo think that they would be remembered by people across the centuries?

710640305.text: Did they ever doubt or falter in their duties? And as for those who never gained a Vision, how did they remain loyal to a god who never showed them favor, even until death?

710640309.text: Yes, you're right. Those with Visions, those without... We are all working towards a future with limitless potential. I mean, that's what they call motivation, am I right?

710640310.text: We're the same. We're not here for the good times in the past, or for some self-realization in the present... But we do this to support one another in leaving something of ourselves behind in the times we live in.

710640311.text: Maybe someday in the far future, The Chasm will also become our memorial.

710640314.text: The pits and the valleys, the sweat of generations of miners... They all bear witness to the tough road we have chosen.

710640312.text: Just like this memorial, this place will be here a hundred, even a thousand years from now, as testament to the fact that the sacrifices made here were not in vain.

710640313.text: Hehe, well, I'm not going to live to see that happen, obviously, but if someone does come here someday to toast us poor miners long after we're gone, that would be more than enough.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for offerings to place before the memorial

710640401.text: The items you need to find are the Helm, the Feather, the Cup, the Sundial, the Flower, and the Spear.

710640402.text: That said, no one's found them all to this day, so...

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for offerings to place before the memorial

710640501.text: It is said that the Flower of Farsight will only make itself known to those with such lofty desires that they might seem crazy to some, and thus is not something ordinary people can witness. Hmm, I wonder what sort of flower that would be?

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for offerings to place before the memorial

710640601.text: I've heard that the Skyfeather can only be obtained from an eagle on a certain mountaintop. That said, never in all my years have I seen someone who can pluck a feather from an eagle...

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for offerings to place before the memorial

710640701.text: They say that the Sundial of Ages would be remembered by all, such that time's passage would not cause it to lose its luster. Perhaps it has never been forgotten or lost after all?

710641301.text: The items you need to find are the Helm, the Feather, the Cup, the Sundial, the Flower, and the Spear.

710641302.text: That said, no one's found them all to this day, so...

subQuests.subQuestName: Offer the items before the memorial

710640801.text: I've heard it said that the Cup of Commons will regain its dignity someday, even if it is obtained by bandits and crooks, or becomes a lowly guest at a humble table... But what does that even mean?

710640901.text: The Helm of Warding is said to rest in the room of an ordinary person, yet may not be summoned forth by anyone but a hero... Well, this was a story I used to fall asleep to, so...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Wang about the treasure

710640502.text: Tell me about the "Flower of Farsight."

710640702.text: Tell me about the Sundial of Ages.

710640802.text: Tell me about the Cup of Commons.

710640902.text: Tell me about the Helm of Warding.

710641002.text: Tell me about the Warrior's Spear.

710641001.text: The Warrior's Spear is rumored to have been set up on a lone cliff, awaiting a valiant soul equal to it. Only then will it be content to once again enter time's eternal flow... Hah, what an exaggerated legend...

710641502.text: Yes, see you... But take care now. The Chasm is still quite a dangerous place.
